```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
set.seed(42)
```
```{r}
for (i in seq_len(10)) {
  print(i)
}
```
```{r}
for (i in seq_len(10)) {
  # add 2 to i
  j <- i + 2
  # take the square root of j
  sj <- sqrt(j)
  # round sj to the nearest whole number
  rsj <- round(sj)
  # print rsj
  print(rsj)
}
```

```{r}
library(cowsay)
species <- c("frog", "stegosaurus", "squirrel", "ghost")

for (spp in species) {
  say(paste("I am a", spp), by = spp)
}
```
```{r}
breakfast <- c("eggs", "bacon", "sausages", "toast")
nums <- seq_len(5)

break_df <- tibble()

for (i in seq_len(10)) {
  item <- sample(breakfast, size = 1)
  num <- sample(nums, size = 1)
  row <- tibble(
    item = item,
    count = num
  )
  break_df <- bind_rows(break_df, row)
}
gt(break_df)
```
```{r}
coin_toss <- sample(c("Heads", "Tails"), size = 1)
print(coin_toss)
```
```{r}
for (i in seq_len(5)) {
  coin_toss <- sample(c("Heads", "Tails"),
    size = 1
  )
  print(coin_toss)
}
```
```{r}
coin_tosses <- sample(c("Heads", "Tails"),
  size = 5,
  replace = TRUE
)
print(coin_tosses)
```
```{r}
n_successes <- sum(coin_tosses == "Heads")
print(n_successes)
```
```{r}
coin_tosses <- sample(c("Heads", "Tails"),
  size = 5,
  replace = TRUE,
  prob = c(0.7, 0.3)
)
print(coin_tosses)
```
```{r}
bm_vec <- c("Badger", "Mushroom", "Snake")
bm_probs <- c(0.95, 0.04, 0.01)

my_sample <- sample(bm_vec,
  size = 100,
  replace = TRUE,
  prob = bm_probs
)
print(my_sample)
```
